description: Everything an agent needs to write and review Python the way the OCX family does: the quality index and its twelve depth files, the pinned exit-code and stream contract, the process-control and pytest-harness rules, typing and annotation-evaluation policy, HTTP and untrusted-input handling, the dependency-free single-file tool rules, gate adoption mechanics, and the manifest and publishing policy.
name: python-essentials
summary: The OCX Python quality set — standards for typed libraries, subprocess-driven test harnesses, automation bots and dependency-free tools, plus the manifest and distribution policy
